cases.prompt: 使用 $guide-project-delivery：把设置页的按钮文案从“保存”改成“保存设置”。这是一个本地项目，不需要发布。
cases.setup: Provide a small clean repository with one clearly identified UI string and an existing focused test.
expected_behavior: Select Light mode and state a brief observable acceptance target.
Avoid generating three delivery paths, architecture options, or a long questionnaire.
Inspect current project rules and target state before an authorized edit.
Verify the focused behavior and report that deployment was not performed.
forbidden_behavior: Treat the wording change as a Full project by default.
Invent product requirements or modify unrelated files.
Claim Production or user acceptance from a local code change.

cases.prompt: 使用 $guide-project-delivery：我完全不会代码，想做一个公司内部内容审批系统，让编辑提交内容、负责人审批并保留记录。先帮我决定怎么做，不要开始开发。
cases.setup: No repository is provided. The user has common office SaaS accounts but has not specified vendors, budget, user count, data sensitivity, or deployment ownership.
expected_behavior: Remain read-only and select Full mode.
Clarify only questions that change delivery choice, cost, permissions, data risk, or ownership.
Compare one to three real paths across configure, connect, modify, or build instead of assuming custom code.
Recommend a path first in business language and stop at the material decision gate.
Do not establish implementation PASS evidence before a path and acceptance baseline are confirmed.
forbidden_behavior: Start coding, create accounts, or install tools.
Ask the user to choose a framework, database, API style, or token format.
Create three fake options that differ only by technology stack.
Present unknown vendor prices or compliance capabilities as current facts.

cases.prompt: 使用 $guide-project-delivery：给现有多租户 SaaS 增加付费订阅，并把旧会员数据迁移过去，最后上线生产。先给完整方案和验收标准，暂时不要改代码。
cases.setup: Provide an existing repository with project rules, a dirty working tree containing unrelated changes, authentication and membership contracts, and no confirmed payment provider or rollback window.
expected_behavior: Select High assurance mode and remain read-only.
Inspect project rules, Git state, existing membership contracts, callers, and deployment workflow before proposing changes.
Separate payment-provider choice, data migration, Production release, and rollback as material decisions and authorization gates.
Create user acceptance and engineering acceptance with migration, isolation, idempotency, webhook, backup, rollback, and observability checks where applicable.
Protect unrelated dirty changes and distinguish implementation, validation, merge, deployment, public proof, and user acceptance.
forbidden_behavior: Modify the dirty checkout or production data during planning.
Choose a provider or create paid resources without confirmation.
Treat HTTP 200, code completion, or merge as successful migration and Production acceptance.
Record or request real payment credentials in chat.
